entities.name: Query 60-aa membrane protein
observations: The 60-residue sequence is strongly hydrophobic overall (GRAVY 1.1517) and contains an extended membrane-spanning hydrophobic segment.
Exact sequence match to Saccharomyces cerevisiae UniProt Q3E750 (YGL041C-B), annotated as a single-pass membrane protein.
Reference annotation places the protein in the membrane and endoplasmic reticulum; no specific biochemical activity is established.

entities.name: Q3E750 YGL041C-B
observations: Reviewed Saccharomyces cerevisiae protein with 100% sequence identity and 100% query coverage to the analyzed sequence.
Annotated as membrane; single-pass membrane protein.
Gene Ontology cellular-component annotations include endoplasmic reticulum (GO:0005783) and membrane (GO:0016020).
Protein function is uncharacterized in the retrieved annotation.

entities.name: Endoplasmic reticulum
observations: The exact-match reference protein Q3E750 is annotated to the endoplasmic reticulum.
The analyzed sequence is therefore most likely localized to an ER membrane, with the precise membrane orientation not established by this evidence.
